poetry:
The unspoken point
Three blades approach the silence
One remains untouched

Eyes upon the world
See the shape of what may come
Neither bind nor rule
Let the branches find their paths
Bring the possible to light

Sword against the void
Weigh the act against its cost
Neither bend nor break
Hold the balance of the law
Guard the freedom of the one

Trace the ancient thread
Follow every root of truth
Let no shadow speak
Without showing whence it came
Keep the record as it was
